), T1 AS ( SELECT CURDEN_0 AS Sour, CUR_0 AS Dest, CHGRAT_0 AS Rate, CHGSTRDAT_0 AS StartDate, LEAD(CHGSTRDAT_0,1,GETDATE()) OVER (PARTITION BY CUR_0,CURDEN_0 ORDER BY CHGSTRDAT_0 ASC) AS EndDate FROM EXPLOIT.TABCHANGE ), T2 AS ( SELECT T0.Site, T0.Type, T0.Status, T0.CustomerCode, T0.OrderNO, T0.OrderDate, T0.DeliveryPlanDate, IIF(T0.Currency = 'USD', T0.Amount, T0.Amount/T1.Rate) AS USD, IIF(T0.Currency = 'USD', T0.AmountWithTax, T0.AmountWithTax/T1.Rate) AS USDWithTax, T0.LocalAmount, T0.LocalAmountWithTax, T0.LocalCurrency FROM T0 LEFT JOIN T1 ON T1.Dest = 'USD' AND T1.Sour = T0.Currency AND T0.OrderDate >= T1.StartDate AND T1.EndDate > T0.OrderDate )

AND ( (SORDER.SOHTYP_0 IN ('NOR','NOR3','YGES', 'LOC','LOC3') AND SORDERQ.YSOQ_STA_0 = 7) OR SORDER.SOHTYP_0 IN ('REP', 'REP3'))
AND SORDER.SOHTYP_0 IN ('LOC','LOC3') AND SORDERQ.YSOQ_STA_0 != 7
AND 1=2
AND CASE WHEN SORDER.SALFCY_0 IN ('ZHU','HKG','YSH') THEN 'CHINA' ELSE 'OTHER-SITE' END != CASE WHEN SORDER.BPCORD_0 IN ('00870', '00871', '03167') THEN 'CHINA' ELSE 'OTHER-CUSTOMER' END
AND SORDER.SALFCY_0 IN ('ZHU','HKG','YSH') AND SORDER.BPCORD_0 NOT IN ('00870', '00871', '03167')
AND SORDER.SALFCY_0 = #{Site}
), T1 AS ( SELECT CURDEN_0 AS Sour, CUR_0 AS Dest, CHGRAT_0 AS Rate, CHGSTRDAT_0 AS StartDate, LEAD(CHGSTRDAT_0,1,GETDATE()) OVER (PARTITION BY CUR_0,CURDEN_0 ORDER BY CHGSTRDAT_0 ASC) AS EndDate FROM EXPLOIT.TABCHANGE ), T2 AS ( SELECT T0.Site, T0.CustomerCode, T0.DeliveryNO, T0.PNFamily, T0.DeliveryDate, IIF(T0.Currency = 'USD', T0.TotalAmount, T0.TotalAmount/T1.Rate) AS USD, IIF(T0.Currency = 'USD', T0.TotalAmountWithTax, T0.TotalAmountWithTax/T1.Rate) AS USDWithTax, T0.TotalLocalAmount, T0.TotalLocalAmountWithTax, T0.LocalCurrency FROM T0 LEFT JOIN T1 ON T1.Dest = 'USD' AND T1.Sour = T0.Currency AND T0.DeliveryDate >= T1.StartDate AND T1.EndDate > T0.DeliveryDate )
SELECT DISTINCT T2.Site, T2.PNFamily, ROUND(SUM(T2.USD) OVER(PARTITION BY T2.Site), 0) AS SiteAllUSD, ROUND(SUM(T2.USDWithTax) OVER(PARTITION BY T2.Site), 0) AS SiteAllUSDWithTax, ROUND(SUM(T2.TotalLocalAmount) OVER(PARTITION BY T2.Site), 0) AS SiteAllLocal, ROUND(SUM(T2.TotalLocalAmountWithTax) OVER(PARTITION BY T2.Site), 0) AS SiteAllLocalWithTax, ROUND(SUM(T2.USD) OVER(PARTITION BY T2.Site, T2.PNFamily), 0) AS SumUSD, ROUND(SUM(T2.USDWithTax) OVER(PARTITION BY T2.Site, T2.PNFamily), 0) AS SumUSDWithTax, ROUND(SUM(T2.TotalLocalAmount) OVER(PARTITION BY T2.Site, T2.PNFamily), 0) AS SumLocal, ROUND(SUM(T2.TotalLocalAmountWithTax) OVER(PARTITION BY T2.Site, T2.PNFamily), 0) AS SumLocalWithTax, T2.LocalCurrency FROM T2 ORDER BY SumUSD DESC OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT #{Limit} ROWS ONLY
